svg.text: One action, every way in. One Laravel config.
No Swift, no Kotlin, no Xcode project surgery.
Search the phone for your app and the actions
come up as tappable rows. They are automation
blocks in the Shortcuts app too — from install.
search the app → tap the action
registers at install · nothing for users to enable
Up to six actions become real Quick Settings
tiles. Every action also gets a URL — write it
to an NFC sticker, a QR code, or a routine.
no app launch · six frozen slots survive updates
